title: FIFO 的 Belady 异常：帧数增加反而缺页更多
expected_output:
reference string = 1,2,3,4,1,2,5,1,2,3,4,5
=== FIFO ===
  frames=3  faults=9
  frames=4  faults=10
  more frames -> MORE faults => BELADY ANOMALY
=== LRU (stack algorithm) ===
  frames=3  faults=10
  frames=4  faults=8
  more frames -> faults never increase (monotone non-increasing)
